verdict.rationale: Cline can execute terminal commands autonomously and reacts to output live (cline-docs-14, cline-docs-4), and its Kanban/parallel-agent mode explicitly does 'auto-commit' per task (cline-docs-5), implying it can stage and commit changes; general shell access would let it run git branch/gh pr commands too. However, there's no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'create PR' or 'write commit message' workflow/feature, only implied capability through generic tool/terminal use. Missing for 10: explicit first-party docs or examples showing Cline creating branches or opening pull requests, and any commit-message-generation feature.
